chunks: Ali Bin Ibrahim Bin Hashim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, who said:

I heard Abu Ja‘far (عليه السلام) saying: “There is no truth with anyone among the people, nor correctness, and no one among the people judges with a true judgment except that which came out from us, Ahl al-Bayt. And when matters become branched and confused for them, the error is from them and the correctness is from ‘Ali (عليه السلام).”

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the People of the Household, the divinely guided family of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.تَشَعَّبَتْ: became divided, branched out, or grew complicated
key_terms.يَقْضِي: issues judgment or decides a matter

ai.seo_question: According to al-Kafi, where do truth and correct judgment come from when people differ?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms that truth and correct judgment are found in what proceeds from Ahl al-Bayt (عليهم السلام). It presents Imam ‘Ali (عليه السلام) as the source of correctness when people differ and become confused in their affairs.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim Bin Hashim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Ibn  Muskan, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,

‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘There isn’t any truth with anyone from the people, nor any correctness, nor is any one from the people judging with a rightful judgment except what came out from us<sup>asws</sup> the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household, and when the matters branched out with them, the errors were from them and the correctness was from Ali<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from ibn Muskan from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following.

“I heard abu Ja‘far (a.s.) say, ‘No one of the people has anything true with him, or correct nor does anyone of the people judge with truth except by means of what is made available from Ahl al-Bayt (members of the family of Prophet Muhammad). When the affairs grow branches and scatter chaotically the mistake would be from them and the correct solution from Ali (a.s.).”
